name: smwgraphics-mystical-ninja-starring-goemon-pause-menu
title: Mystical Ninja Starring Goemon - Pause Menu
description:
A very unusual background seen in the pause menu from Mystical Ninja Starring Goemon. It's a karakusa pattern, or also known as, winding plant, which the meaning is "luck and prosperity".

Common seen being used in the bags that japanese burglar figures carry in their back. In the original game, it is like a curtain, which moves back and further to the direction of the screen.

Can fit some unusual levels, maybe.
